title: Neighbourhood presentation of the strict-local derived mate
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point, $g:S_{(s)}\to S$ its strict-henselization map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], $X'=X\times_S S_{(s)}$, $p:X'\to X$, and $f':X'\to S_{(s)}$. For every $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(X_{et}))$ and $n\in\mathbf Z$, the map $m=\Gamma(S_{(s)},H^n(\mathrm{mate}_K))$ has a global cohomology continuity presentation with base $T=X$, object $K$, and degree $n$ [def-weil-pbc-global-cohomology-continuity-presentation]. The source cocone, using the small-model source legs [def-weil-pbc-small-model-cohomology-germs], is colimiting and the composite of each source leg with $m$ is the canonical projection pullback. No target colimit or invertibility assertion is made. All mate target comparisons in this statement use the small coordinate-ring colimit model of [def-weil-pbc-small-model-mate-projection-data].

source.place: Tags 03Q9 (theorem-higher-direct-images), 03Q8 and 0GIT; presentation of neighbourhood restriction maps

proof.text: Choose canonical StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry using the adopted nonempty_strictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry theorem directly; the small-model existence wrapper is an exact alias and is unnecessary. Its smallModelLegs and smallModelIsLimit API transports the cone onto the original small coordinate-ring colimit. Choose the projection identifications with smallModel_nonempty_strictLocalMateProjectionData. The cohomology domain diagram and source legs are the explicit small-model constructions, not the canonical strictLocalization source maps.

Apply smallModel_isColimit_strictLocalCohomologySourceLegs to the derived direct image. Assemble every field of GlobalCohomologyContinuityPresentation using this source colimit, the original geometry, the projection equations and the exact strict-local Leray target isomorphism. No continuity or invertibility theorem is used.

Use the general pointed-section-cone restriction on strictLocalSectionCone, the existing exact-sections instance for the small colimit model, and the general exact-global-sections Leray comparison wherever the former specialized restriction API was used. The cone restriction has the same section formulas, its germ predicate is definitionally identical, and uniqueness identifies the chosen stalk maps. All other argument steps and all scheme models stay as before.

The geometry parameter is now the official canonical strictLocalization model. Use [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-small-model-geometry-transport] to express its cone on the original small colimit model. Replace legs, limit and the two component equations by smallModelLegs, smallModelIsLimit, smallModelFirst and smallModelOver. All cohomology objects, structural morphisms, source and target maps remain those in the original statement; the rest of the existing proof is unchanged.

lean.statement: theorem nonempty_strictLocalBaseChange_continuityPresentation {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})) (n : ℤ) : Nonempty (GlobalCohomologyContinuityPresentation X K n ((Sheaf.Γ (Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).map ((mateEquiv (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).derivedPlus (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).derivedPlus (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).toCommSq).hom)) |>.natTrans.app K))))
